description: A treaty established within the last decade between human and vampire societies that ended decades or centuries of war. Vampires remain outside human settlements. Humans do not hunt vampires who abide by the Compact. Violations are tried before the Holy See tribunal.
rules: Vampires must remain outside human settlements. Humans do not hunt compliant vampires. Violations are tried before tribunal. Vampire society signed from a position of power, not morality, and will not defend members who violate it.

details.Terms: Vampires remain outside human settlements; humans do not hunt compliant vampires
details.Tribunal: Violations tried before the Holy See, since vampire society exiled Cordelia and will not defend her
details.Why It Exists: Vampires gained legal protection and territory; humans gained safety from predation
details.Opposition: Vampires who see it as weakness; humans who see it as compromise with evil
details.Irony for Cordelia: She left vampire society because they viewed humans as cattle. The Compact codified separation. She broke the law because she rejected that separation, because she saw human children as worth saving. Now she will be tried by humans for crossing a line she never believed in.
